newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA Alberta pipeline outage starts Sunday.
newsitem.headline: NOVA Alberta pipeline outage starts Sunday.

text.p: NOVA Corp unit NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd was slated to start scheduled maintenance on one of its main Alberta pipelines on Sunday, taking about one billion cubic feet of natural gas off the system, an NGTL official said on Wednesday.

NGTL planned to start cutting flows on its Grande Prairie mainline in northwestern Alberta on Sunday before starting in-line inspection work early on Monday, NGTL team leader of operations planning Dave Schultz said in a telephone interview.
Schultz said the gas flow was expected to resume late on Thursday, July 17.
Traders said on Wednesday that Alberta natural gas prices rose in anticipation of the big outage. AECO spot gas was quoted at C$1.58 per gigajoule, up about three cents from Tuesday.
A Calgary-based marketer said he expected prices to remain strong next week amid the cut in supply.
